Under claude-md-and-agents-md every AGENTS.md is loaded beside CLAUDE.md. Under managed-only the project's and the person's instruction files are dropped and the organization's managed ones kept. Under claude-md the engine's walk stands alone. claude-md-or-agents-md is the default.

mods.description: AgentBBS cross-host agent federation for ruflo (ADR-164). Phase 2 (v3.40.0) adds signed cross-host federation: federation_bbs_identity (persistent Ed25519 node identity), federation_bbs_peer_add (pin a peer by nodeId + public key), federation_bbs_peers (audit/unpin), federation_bbs_serve (read-only pull endpoint), and federation_bbs_sync (pull pinned peers and union-merge what verifies). Coordinates work ownership via claim messages (ClaimIssued/Released/Handoff/Ack). agentbbs lives in optionalDependencies; every handler gracefully degrades to {degraded:true} when the package is missing (ADR-150 pattern). As a mod (ADR-445 pattern): a tighten-only tool guard, a local slash command, and a status file the console shows.

mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.description: Prompt-cache meter above the Claude Code prompt: how many tokens each request read from, wrote to and sent past the cache, a live countdown to the cache's expiry, and what to do about it (keep going, compact or clear). The TTL follows Claude Code's own rules for your account (1 hour on a Claude subscription, 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits, plus the TTL variables and setting) and corrects itself from request timing. When Claude Code will compact an idle conversation by itself, it counts down to that too. /cache opens a per-turn table.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: universal-audit-log
mods.description: One hook on * that records every event on $ (tool calls, prompts, turns, other plugins' fs/http/process calls) as JSON lines with origin plugin and tier, duration and outcome, including denials. Buffered and flushed to a JSONL file through $.fs at the end of every turn.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: aitmpl
mods.description: /aitmpl opens a side pane for the aitmpl.com catalog: search box, the site's Browse menu with an icon, colour and count per type, an Installed section (agents, commands, skills and mods found in .claude/ and ~/.claude/), a Popular/Results list with download counts, and view/install on every row. Install runs the fixed CLI argv ($.process.run, validated path, no shell). The catalog is read live through $.http.fetch; browsing costs no tokens.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: jev-model-router
mods.description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort and model at turn.step, in both directions, falling back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: jev-skill-suggestion
mods.description: Keeps the skill listing out of the context window and lets TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model, pick at most one skill per prompt from the skills' descriptions, the way TypeSafe's skill-suggestion cookbook does: one request ranks every skill and asks whether the prompt needs a skill at all, a second re-reads the top three with their SKILL.md and can reject them all. The winner's SKILL.md is attached to the prompt, so the skills can be hidden from the model altogether (/jev-skill-suggestion:setup makes them user-invocable-only and /context counts them at 0). Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: jev-skill-typeahead
mods.description: Shows, while you type, the skills and subagents Claude will probably call for your prompt: reads the draft on every edit and lists them in the band above the prompt, ranked by keyword match (English or Spanish). When you pause, Jev (TypeSafe's decision model) decides which one will be called and the band marks it. Slash commands are left out, since you run those yourself. Without a Jev key it stays on the instant local match.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: npm-to-pnpm-rewriter
mods.description: Rewrites npm and npx invocations to pnpm (or yarn / bun) before the Bash tool runs them and tells the model what ran through context. A tool.call hook that forwards a modified event (the modifying placement).
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: session-time-machine
mods.description: /timemachine draws the session as a timeline of prompts, tool calls and turn ends from its own transcript. Press a point and give a new instruction: the mod writes a copy of the transcript cut there under a new session id and gives you the `claude --resume` command that continues it, so you can try the other approach without losing this one. Hooks session.start, command.run, turn.complete and ui.render on Pane.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.description: Picks the model and reasoning effort of every subagent: a recommendation by task kind, a band above the prompt, and a saved default that wins.

mods.name: webfetch-cache
mods.description: Short-circuits repeated WebFetch calls for the same URL and prompt within a session, answering { result } from cache without a network round trip. A tool.call hook with TTL and size limits.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: block-destructive-commands
mods.description: Denies Bash commands that match destructive patterns (recursive rm on roots, force push, hard reset, destructive SQL, disk formatting) before they run. A tool.call hook with a Bash matcher that returns { deny } without calling next.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: jev-auto-mode
mods.description: A permission layer driven by a JSON policy: allow, ask or deny every tool call (Bash, edits, web, MCP, subagents, skills), every slash command or skill you type, and every skill preloaded into a subagent. Rules decide first (deny > ask > allow, compound Bash commands split); what no rule covers can go to TypeSafe's Jev, which judges the action against your latest request with thresholds you set. Claude can never edit the policy.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: jev-guardrails
mods.description: Screens every prompt going into the conversation and every reply coming out of it with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model, the way TypeSafe's guardrails cookbook does: one request per message asks a battery of hazard questions (jailbreak, harm or a crime, a diagnosis or a dosage, self-harm) and scores how much harm complying would do. The thresholds live here, in a named policy (strict or permissive), and turn the probabilities into pass, review (the user is asked), block (the prompt is dropped, or the reply withheld) or support. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.
mods.author: claude-code-templates

mods.name: jev-vercel-sandbox
mods.description: A Vercel Sandbox Claude sends work to on purpose: long test runs in the background, someone else's repository, an installer of unknown origin, a bulk change to preview as a patch, a clean build. TypeSafe's Jev reads each Bash command and spots those jobs; by default you are asked whether it runs in the sandbox or locally (confirmSandbox), or it always goes to the sandbox with the question off. Claude also gets sandbox_run, sandbox_jobs, sandbox_result and sandbox_apply. Each job starts from the project as it is now (tracked files, credentials left out) in its own worktree, every result is marked remote, and a job's changes reach your disk only as a patch you apply after a question. /jev-vercel-sandbox starts it and opens a side pane with the jobs. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier without a Jev key.

mods.name: desktop-statusline
mods.description: Status band above the prompt in the Claude Desktop app's Code tab: folder, git branch and state, session age, prompt count and cost, a context meter, 5-hour and weekly plan usage limit meters with reset countdowns, last-turn model, duration and cache hit rate, idle time against the prompt-cache TTL, compactions, server-side tool use, subagents by state, and one row per workflow run with live done/failed counts. A notification (or toast) at 80% and 95% of a usage limit. Draws only on the desktop surface, so a CLI statusLine is left alone.
mods.author: George Liu

mods.name: cache-warmer
mods.description: Keep the main conversation's prompt cache warm by automatically forking its last request, tools denied and billed like any request, shortly before the cache expires; switch its lifetime between 5m and 1h, and show each refresh's cost and estimated saving.

mods.name: jev-router
mods.description: Asks TypeSafe Jev before each task which Claude model and effort fit best, then runs the turn on it
mods.author: Dominic Rico Gómez

mods.name: pixelband
mods.description: Animated pixel art above your Claude Code prompt that reacts while Claude works: eight scenes, or your own image or GIF. Zero tokens.
mods.author: Furqan Khan

mods.name: idle-compact
mods.description: Compact once after 50 idle minutes, while the 1h prompt cache is still warm.

mods.author: Thomas Stagl

mods.name: statuspane
mods.description: A floating status card above the Claude Code prompt: model, effort, context, 5h/week limits, cost, directory and branch, GitHub CI and deploys: with clickable settings and a progress-row API any script or mod can feed.
mods.author: Anji Xu

mods.name: tg-pane
mods.description: Telegram in a Claude Code pane: private chats with replies, search, message actions (reply, edit, delete, react, forward), voice transcripts, categories (all chats and folders), model summaries of channels

mods.name: muslim-mods
mods.description: Prayer times, the Hijri date, adhkar, a daily ayah, sunnah fasting, Ramadan, Jumu'ah, tasbih and a salah break in Claude Code, each switched on or off from one dashboard: /muslim.
mods.author: Adam Suchi Hafizullah

mods.name: almanac
mods.description: KOZMOS Almanac: what this session is made of. Slash commands run, skills invoked, subagent types spawned, MCP servers used, models seen, plugins whose tools were called and tool families, each with counts and first-use time, as ranked bars and tag clouds; plus the engine version and how many installed commands went unused. /almanac toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: aurora
mods.description: KOZMOS Aurora: northern lights above the prompt while the model thinks. Shifting curtains whose intensity and speed follow the effort level (low is gentle, max is wild), a calmer single wave while it responds, and a label like 'thinking · xhigh · 12s'. /aurora toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: ballast
mods.description: KOZMOS Ballast: a context coach. A toast when the context window passes warnAt, then a band with an anchor and a water-level gauge at actAt: "⚓ ctx 89%: compact before the next big task" with Compact now (queued to the end of a running turn) and Not now. Optional auto-compaction between turns, and a before→after toast for every compaction. /ballast toggles the band.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: blackbox
mods.description: KOZMOS Blackbox: a flight recorder above the prompt. A live Gantt of the current turn: the main loop and each subagent on its own lane, every tool call a bar in its family color, model requests as ticks, a moving now cursor on an auto-scaling time axis; the last turn stays dimmed until the next. /blackbox toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: breadcrumbs
mods.description: KOZMOS Breadcrumbs: the session's web trail in a sidebar. WebSearch queries with result counts and top hits, WebFetch URLs with status and size, and browser-like MCP visits, grouped by domain with a monogram badge, clickable links and a copy-all-as-Markdown button. /breadcrumbs toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: bridge
mods.description: KOZMOS Bridge: a mission-control sidebar. Model and effort, context fill, 5-hour and weekly limits with reset countdowns, session cost and burn rate, git branch and tree state, CPU/RAM/GPU, live subagents and the tool running now. /bridge toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: chronicle
mods.description: KOZMOS Chronicle: the session as a timeline. Prompts, turn ends with duration, tool count and spend, subagents spawned and finished, commits and pushes, failed tools, compactions, and rate-limit and context milestones, each stamped HH:MM:SS, newest first, with filters. /chronicle toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: clawdling
mods.description: KOZMOS Clawdling: a pixel crab companion that lives above the prompt. It blinks and sways, scuttles while tools run, thinks in bubbles, sweats past 80% context, dozes near the 5-hour limit and dances on a five-turn streak. It earns XP from tools and turns, levels up into a party hat, sunglasses, a scarf and a crown, and quips about what it sees. /clawdling toggles it, /clawdling feed treats it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: compass
mods.description: KOZMOS Compass: the single most useful hint under the prompt. In order: the 5-hour limit near its end with its reset, a context window near full, agents still working, uncommitted changes after edits, a draft left waiting; otherwise the engine's own hint. /compass toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: epilogue
mods.description: KOZMOS Epilogue: a recap band after every turn. Duration, tool families as colored chips, files written, subagents spawned, tokens and estimated cost, the session cost delta and failed tools, with an optional AI one-liner. /epilogue opens the last 20 recaps.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: faultline
mods.description: KOZMOS Faultline: the error lens in a sidebar. Every failed or denied tool call, refused or errored turn and API error, grouped by a masked signature with count, first and last seen, the agents that hit it, the full first error (expandable) and a copy button, under a severity strip of the last 10 minutes. /faultline toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: gearbox
mods.description: KOZMOS Gearbox: tool analytics for the session. Per tool its calls, errors and error rate, average, p95 and max duration and total time as a sorted bar chart, the five slowest calls, calls per minute, and the main loop against subagents. /gearbox toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: gitscope
mods.description: KOZMOS Gitscope: a git radar sidebar. Branch, upstream and ahead/behind, staged/changed/new/conflict counts and stashes, the last 8 commits on a graph rail, per-file +/- histograms from git diff, and a marker on every file this session edited. /gitscope toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: glyphfall
mods.description: KOZMOS Glyphfall: matrix rain of tool activity above the prompt while Claude works. Every tool call drops its name and detail as a wave of letters, colored by tool family, with bright heads and fading tails, over a sparse rain of katakana; the last five tools sit below as colored chips. /glyphfall toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: halo
mods.description: KOZMOS Halo: a one-row mood line above the prompt whose color and motion tell what Claude is doing: calm blue breathing when idle, a violet flow while it requests and writes, a magenta shimmer while it thinks, the running tool's color racing across, a red flash when a tool fails, an amber blink when it waits for you. /halo toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: heartline
mods.description: KOZMOS Heartline: a neon EKG of the session drawn above the prompt. Every tool call is a spike colored by its family, every model request a blip, a failed tool a red inverted spike; the trace drifts green to red with context fill, with a live bpm (tool calls per minute) and ctx readout. /heartline toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: helm
mods.description: KOZMOS Helm: one-press settings profiles in a sidebar. Seven built-in ways of working (Token saver, Fast flow, Max quality, Plan first, Guarded, Autopilot, Quiet focus) plus your own saved setups; each shows exactly what it changes, lets you leave any step out, applies /config rows the way the menu does, saves effort for the model in use at once, and every activation can be undone. /helm toggles it; <profile>, apply <profile>, save <name>, rm <name>, undo, list.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: hivemind
mods.description: KOZMOS Hivemind: the agent swarm as a live tree. The main loop at the root and every subagent beneath its parent, each with a status glyph, type and task, model and effort, elapsed time, requests, tokens, estimated spend, context fill and the tool it runs now. /hivemind toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: hourglass
mods.description: KOZMOS Hourglass: the limit oracle. For the 5-hour, weekly and spend windows: percent used, reset countdown, a burn rate learned across sessions, the time to 100 % and a verdict on whether the reset comes first. Toasts at 80 % and 95 %, an optional status line. /hourglass toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: kozmos
mods.description: KOZMOS Hub: the launcher for the whole bundle. /kozmos opens a starfield sidebar listing every KOZMOS mod by where it draws, which ones are installed in this session, and a button that runs each mod's own command.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: launchpad
mods.description: KOZMOS Launchpad: a pane of big launch buttons. It learns your most-used slash commands as you run them, keeps pinned favorites and saved prompts, and runs a command or fills the prompt box in one press. /launchpad toggles it; save <text>, rm <n>, pin <cmd>, unpin <cmd>, list.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: laurels
mods.description: KOZMOS Laurels: 32 achievements earned from what the session does (Hydra, Night Owl, Cache Wizard, Bug Squasher, Polyglot, Centurion, Committed and more), kept across sessions with their unlock dates. A toast and a six-second celebration band on each unlock; /laurels opens the medal gallery with progress toward the locked ones.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: lofi
mods.description: KOZMOS Lofi: generative lo-fi music while Claude works. Four original synthesized loops (focus, deep, night, sunny: warm chord pads, an electric piano, soft kick and hats with swing, vinyl crackle) loop from the start of a turn until it ends, and stop when Claude is idle. Opt-in: /lofi on. A tiny band shows '♪ lofi · deep' with a dancing equalizer while it plays.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: mantra
mods.description: KOZMOS Mantra: a themed spinner. The working line's word rotates through a pack of original gerunds (cosmic, zen, pirate, turkish, hacker) and its tail names the tool running now with its elapsed time, or the effort while the model thinks. /mantra <pack> switches, /mantra off hands the line back.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: marquee
mods.description: KOZMOS Marquee: a status-line ticker. Model and effort, context fill, 5-hour and weekly limits with the reset countdown, session cost, git branch with ahead and dirty counts, and the tool running now, refreshed every second; it scrolls like a marquee when longer than its width. /marquee toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: mosaic
mods.description: KOZMOS Mosaic: a GitHub-style activity calendar across sessions. 26 weeks of days colored by turns, tool calls, tokens or dollars, with the current and longest streak, the best day, totals and today's line. /mosaic toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: orrery
mods.description: KOZMOS Orrery: subagents as planets circling a central sun above the prompt. Running agents orbit at a speed set by their tokens per second, finished ones settle into a faint outer ring, failed ones flash a red cross; a legend names up to four with type and elapsed time. /orrery toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: polaroid
mods.description: KOZMOS Polaroid: /polaroid snapshots the session as a self-contained dark-neon HTML report in .kozmos/reports: model, duration, cost, tokens, context peak, rate limits, tool calls by family, a timeline of turns, subagents, files touched and commands run, all collected live. It answers with the path and copies it. /polaroid md writes Markdown instead.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: questline
mods.description: KOZMOS Questline: task progress above the prompt. One segmented bar for the session's todos and tasks (done green, running violet and pulsing, waiting gray), the count, what is running now and for how long. Hides itself two minutes after everything is done. /questline toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: relay
mods.description: KOZMOS Relay: the API latency lab in a sidebar. Every model request of the main loop and its subagents with latency, time to first token, model, effort, input/output/cache tokens, tokens per second and stop reason; a latency histogram, tokens/sec over time, model mix, p50/p95, the slowest five and cache-read share per request. /relay toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: resonance
mods.description: KOZMOS Resonance: a synthesized soundscape for the session. A soft tick per tool, a bonk on failures, a gong after long turns, a bell when a subagent finishes, an alarm when a rate-limit window crosses 80% or 95%, a chime on the first turn. /resonance mutes.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: skies
mods.description: KOZMOS Skies: the session's weather above the prompt. Tool failures, context and rate-limit pressure, stalls and the local hour make clear skies, clouds, rain, storms with lightning, fog, a starry night, or a rainbow after a storm clears; an animated scene and a forecast line. /skies toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: spectra
mods.description: KOZMOS Spectra: the context X-ray. The context window broken down by category as a heat grid with a ranked legend, context growth per turn, and an estimate of how many turns remain before auto-compact. /spectra toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: stamp
mods.description: KOZMOS Stamp: a receipt on every finished turn. The closing 'Baked for 42s' line becomes a compact row of duration, tool calls by family as colored chips, tokens in and out, the turn's cost and the context fill with its change. /stamp toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: storyboard
mods.description: KOZMOS Storyboard: Claude narrates its own progress. A chapter tool the model calls at each phase change drives a band above the prompt: the chapter title, a five-stage rail (explore, plan, build, verify, ship) with the active stage glowing, step 3/5 and a note. /storyboard toggles the band, /storyboard log opens the chapter history.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: switchboard
mods.description: KOZMOS Switchboard: an MCP observatory sidebar. Every MCP server in the session with its tools, calls, errors, average and p95 latency, last call and a status lamp (healthy, erroring, idle, busy); servers with no calls yet too, and per-tool rows on expand. On the desktop a patch bay with glowing cables to the active servers. /switchboard toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: taskforge
mods.description: KOZMOS Taskforge: a live kanban of the session's tasks. TodoWrite lists and TaskCreate/TaskUpdate tasks fall into Pending, In progress and Done columns with the active form, time in the column and the owning agent, under a progress bar. /taskforge toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: tempo
mods.description: KOZMOS Tempo: a Pomodoro focus timer above the prompt. A tomato, the phase, a ring (desktop) or a sizzling bar (terminal) and the time left; long breaks every fourth round, a toast at each phase end and a tally of focus rounds per day. /tempo start [work] [break], stop, skip.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: terminus
mods.description: KOZMOS Terminus: the session's shell history in a sidebar. Every Bash and PowerShell call of the main loop and its subagents with command, description, cwd, exit status, duration, output size and who ran it; filters for failed and slow runs, copy and re-run buttons. /terminus toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: thermal
mods.description: KOZMOS Thermal: a heatmap of the files this session touches. Reads, edits, writes and searches per file, a heat score that cools over time, grouped as a directory tree under the session folder: an indented heat tree on the terminal, a squarified treemap on the desktop, switchable by heat, reads or edits. /thermal toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: thrift
mods.description: KOZMOS Thrift: a frugal mode. /thrift on|off|auto; while on, every prompt carries a short note asking Claude to be economical (targeted reads, no broad searches or subagents unless needed, concise answers). Auto turns it on when the 5-hour or weekly limit passes autoAt and off after the window resets. A band with a spinning coin, and /thrift compares the average cost of thrift turns with normal ones.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: throttle
mods.description: KOZMOS Throttle: a car dashboard above the prompt. Speedometer of output tokens per second, fuel gauge of the 5-hour limit, temperature of the context, an odometer of session dollars, and check-engine, fuel and overheat lamps. /throttle toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: tidewater
mods.description: KOZMOS Tidewater: the live diff of the current turn as tides above the prompt. Every file Claude edits gets its own pool of rolling waves, a green swell for added lines and a red ebb for removed ones, with file chips and totals like '+128 −42 · 6 files'. From the first edit of a turn until the next prompt. /tidewater toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: tokenomics
mods.description: KOZMOS Tokenomics: the cost lab. Session cost as the headline, an estimated split by model and by token type, cache hit ratio, burn per hour, cost per turn, a pace forecast and daily and weekly totals across sessions with a 14-day chart. /tokenomics toggles the sidebar.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: toolmarks
mods.description: KOZMOS Toolmarks: badges on tool rows. Each finished call gets a family-colored glyph and its duration at the row's end, Bash calls their exit status, failed calls a red mark, and a folded group its total time and failures. /toolmarks toggles them.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: verdict
mods.description: KOZMOS Verdict: test, build and lint results above the prompt. Spots the test runners, type checkers, linters and builds Claude runs (vitest, jest, pytest, go test, cargo, dotnet, mocha, bun, tsc, eslint, npm run build, maven, gradle…), parses pass/fail/skip and error counts, and shows chips like '✓ vitest 142 · ✗ jest 3 failed · ✓ tsc 0 errors' with a red pulse on failures and a sparkline of the last 10 runs. /verdict opens a pane of recent runs with the failing test names and first error lines.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: vitals
mods.description: KOZMOS Vitals: a btop-style machine monitor sidebar. CPU with a braille history graph, RAM bar and history, disk use, NVIDIA GPU load, memory and temperature, process count, and the Claude side: session time, tool calls, running agents. Samples every 2 s only while open. /vitals toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: warden
mods.description: KOZMOS Warden: a guard for destructive shell commands. Before Claude or a subagent runs rm -rf on a broad path, git push --force, reset --hard, clean -fd, DROP TABLE, mkfs, format, curl | sh and their kin, warden asks you (Allow once / Deny) and refuses when no one can answer. A band flashes for 8 s after a block; /warden lists the rules and this session's log.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: warpdrive
mods.description: KOZMOS Warpdrive: a starfield at warp above the prompt. Stars stream out of the center at the speed of Claude's live output token rate: a slow drift while it thinks, hyperspace streaks while it writes. When a turn ends, a jump flash and a line like '⇢ arrived · 42s · 18.4k tok'. /warpdrive toggles it.
mods.author: KOZMOS

mods.name: mod
mods.description: 5dive telemetry producer, seat panel, command surface and tool-call policy guard for Claude Code function hooks (early access). Publishes turn and session boundaries and the account's usage reading from inside the harness process to a per-seat JSONL sink, so the heartbeat, the pacing floor and the self-update's pending-restart sweep can read a first-class signal instead of inferring idle/busy from pane samples and the task board. Registers /task and /gate, which dispatch to the 5dive CLI in-process. It also draws one line above the prompt naming the row the seat holds, its gate, its grader and its token burn against its budget, at zero context cost. On the NON-FRESH seats it can additionally compact the conversation at a turn boundary, so the next dispatched goal lands on a summary instead of the whole accumulated window; that half pins any unanswered human gate or standing directive back into the compacted transcript. And it enforces a table-driven deny list over tool calls (policy/guard.json), so a rule that today costs every seat tokens on every turn and is caught after the fact is refused before the tool runs, with the reason handed to the model. Every capability is off unless the seat opts in; the compact hook is the only one that rewrites a call and the guard is the only one that can refuse one.

mods.description: Dispatch Pilot：一个在 Claude 之外的决策模型（默认 Perplexity 的 pplx，没有 Perplexity key 时退回 TypeSafe 的 Jev，也可以固定用 Jev）在你每次发消息时决定主 agent 这一轮的 effort，每一步都按这一档发出，一轮进行中每隔几步再判断一次；也为主 agent 派出的每个 agent 和 Workflow 脚本里的每个 agent 按 Artificial Analysis 的基准选模型和 effort（sonnet 和 opus 至少 medium）。主 agent 的模型从不改变，prompt cache 不受影响（只在 Claude Code 订阅下成立；Bedrock、Vertex 和网关上切换 effort 会让缓存失效）。它还不让主 agent 读完整的 skill 列表，改为在你发消息时推荐合适的几个，一轮中途主 agent 可以用 find_skill 工具查 skill。它还能替 agent 看图核对：agent 交上截图或录屏和几条检查项，由 TypeSafe 的 Jev（没有 TypeSafe key 时用 pplx）一两秒内回答过、不过或没把握，不必自己看；可选的截图接管把 agent 自己生成的图换成一句说明，带图路由按参考图的复杂度定 effort（这两项默认关。图没法脱敏：带图路由会把你贴的参考图发给 TypeSafe 或 Perplexity，看图核对会把 agent 交上来的图发过去；截图接管自己不发图）。agent 的工具调用失败累计到一定次数时强制升高它的 effort（haiku agent 的 effort 到顶后改用 sonnet），除非这些失败本来就在意料之中。所有判断和理由都放在看板上：prompt 上方的 band 列出本轮每个 agent 的模型和 effort，脚部一个短摘要，/dp 打开的依据面板写明每个决定的依据和决策日志。

mods.name: big-diff-nudge
mods.description: Suggests splitting the change once your edits added or removed more than 500 lines since the last git commit. A successful commit resets the count.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: big-file-guard
mods.description: Asks before a Write creates content over 1 MB, or git add names a file over 5 MB. Measures the files with find.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: branch-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, read with git status after each Bash call and file edit.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: branches
mods.description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list, read with git. Never deletes. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: break-nudge
mods.description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: british-english
mods.description: British spelling and terms in prose (colour, organise, licence as a noun). Code identifiers stay as they are.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: bullet-mode
mods.description: Replies as short bullet lists, at most one sentence per bullet, unless you ask for code.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the share of prompt tokens the cache served this session (cache 87%). A high share means cheaper, faster turns.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: caveman-mode
mods.description: Prose in short caveman speech ("Fix bug. Test pass."), still accurate. Code and commands stay exact.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: changelog
mods.description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), read with git log and grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: chmod-guard
mods.description: Asks before chmod makes files world-writable (777, a+w, o+w) or chmod or chown runs recursively on a broad path (/, a system folder, a home folder).
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: ci-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (ci passed, ci failed, ci running), asked of the gh CLI every 2 minutes; branch read with git. Hidden without gh.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: ci-config-guard
mods.description: Asks before Write or Edit changes CI config: .github/workflows, .gitlab-ci.yml or .circleci/config.yml.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: clippy
mods.description: One helpful toast per session per trigger, in the classic paperclip voice: when you edit a migrations folder, a Dockerfile or a GitHub workflow, or run rm -rf. At most one toast per turn.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: code-only
mods.description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: command-pack
mods.description: The five original slash commands in one mod: /receipt, /standup, /changelog, /pr-description and /handoff. They read git; /handoff also writes .claude/handoff.md. They copy results to the clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: commit-msg
mods.description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff, read with git. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: commit-nudge
mods.description: Suggests a commit at turn end after 8 or more file edits since the last git commit. One toast per batch of edits; a successful git commit resets the count.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: conflicts
mods.description: Adds /conflicts: tracked files that still hold merge conflict markers, with line numbers, found with git grep. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: context-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a 10 cell bar of the context window used, yellow from 60 percent, red from 80.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: context-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of how full the context window is: the percent as a bar, the tokens used, and a short tip past 75 percent. Open it with /context-pane.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: conventional-commits
mods.description: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, imperative, under 72 characters.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: cost-pane
mods.description: A live side pane with the session cost, the cost of each of the last 10 turns as a bar, and the average per turn. Open it with /cost-pane.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: creator-band
mods.description: The creator band in one row above the prompt: turn timer, count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines (read with git), and the daily streak flame.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: cron-guard
mods.description: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: ctx-nudge
mods.description: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: curl-pipe-guard
mods.description: Asks before a download is piped into a shell or interpreter (curl | sh, wget -O- | bash, bash <(curl ...)).
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: daily-spend
mods.description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: db-reset-guard
mods.description: Asks before a framework wipes a database: prisma migrate reset, rails or rake db:drop and db:reset, alembic downgrade, django flush, supabase db reset, knex rollback --all.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: debug-print-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast naming the count of console.log, print(, debugger and dbg! lines your edits added this turn. Only code files count.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: deploy-guard
mods.description: Asks before a production deploy: vercel --prod, netlify deploy --prod, firebase deploy, fly deploy, gcloud app deploy, eb deploy, heroku rollback, serverless deploy to prod.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: deps
mods.description: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the repo root. No network. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: desktop-notify
mods.description: Shows a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input: osascript on macOS, notify-send elsewhere when it is installed. The text is the project name and a short status only.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: dev-band
mods.description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files (read with git status), wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: diff-stats
mods.description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: discord-notify
mods.description: Posts to a Discord webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: docker-guard
mods.description: Asks before Docker commands that delete data: system, volume or image prune, rm -f, volume rm and compose down -v.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: docs-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: docstring-mode
mods.description: Every new or changed public function gets a short doc comment in the language's normal style.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: eli5-mode
mods.description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: env-check
mods.description: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env at the git repo root, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: env-example-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when edits add a reference to an environment variable (process.env, os.environ, os.getenv, Deno.env) that .env.example does not list. Reads only .env.example names, never .env.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: env-exfil-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command prints your environment, echoes a secret variable or sends local data to a remote host.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: envinfo
mods.description: Adds /envinfo: versions of git, node, npm, python3, go, rustc and docker if installed, by running each (2 s limit), and the OS. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: epic-bar
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: epics-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: error-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: exit-badge
mods.description: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: explore-pack
mods.description: Five read-only repo exploration commands in one mod: /tree, /deps, /authors, /scripts and /env-check. They read git and project files. They copy results to the clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: file-links
mods.description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: file-owners
mods.description: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

warnings.message: UI hook source contains control-character strings. Review any values passed to next() as rewritten props.text; the scanner does not trace whether these strings reach that call.

mods.name: files-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: focus-pack
mods.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: fun-pack
mods.description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: git-history-guard
mods.description: Asks before git commands that throw away work or rewrite history: reset --hard, clean, rebase, filter-branch, filter-repo, push --delete, branch -D and stash clear.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: git-pane
mods.description: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: gitignore-check
mods.description: Asks before git add or commit when secret-looking files are not ignored or are already tracked. Checks with git ls-files.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: gitmoji-commits
mods.description: Commit messages start with the matching gitmoji (✨ feat, 🐛 fix). Composes with conventional-commits: emoji goes before the type.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: guard-devops
mods.description: Asks before harsh DevOps commands: destructive Docker, Kubernetes and Helm calls, CI config edits, broad chmod and chown, and git commands that lose work. Add infra-guard for plain kubectl delete.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: guard-essentials
mods.description: Asks only before harsh or disaster commands: destructive infra, git and SQL, piping downloads into a shell, sudo, leaking or committing secrets. Reads git. The quiet choice for daily work.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: guard-pack
mods.description: The 15 core Baselane guards in one mod (secrets, git, infra, packages, path jail). Some read git, measure files with find, read HOME with printenv, or check where a path really lands.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: haiku-commits
mods.description: Commit messages get a normal conventional-commit first line, then a 5-7-5 haiku about the change in the body.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: heatmap
mods.description: Adds /heatmap: a 12-week calendar grid of the days you used Claude Code, like a contribution graph, shaded by turns, naming your busiest day.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: hotspots
mods.description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: infra-guard
mods.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: issue-links
mods.description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: json-pretty
mods.description: Bash output that is one long line of JSON is drawn pretty-printed, folded after 30 lines. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: junior-mode
mods.description: Explains each step and why, and defines jargon once, for a learner.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: k8s-guard
mods.description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: langs
mods.description: Counts the file types Claude edits across sessions and adds /langs: a bar list of the types edited most, each file counted once per session.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: latte-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt that counts the session cost in lattes. Set the latte price in the plugin options.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: licenses
mods.description: Adds /licenses: the licence of each direct dependency, from node_modules and Python dist-info at the git repo root. Shows unknown when it cannot tell. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: lifecycle-pack
mods.description: The four original lifecycle mods in one: runs your formatter, sends ntfy.sh pushes for long commands and input waits, and appends to ~/.claude/journal.log.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: loc
mods.description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: lockfile-guard
mods.description: Asks before a lockfile is written or edited by hand; the package manager should change it.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: lockfile-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when dependencies in package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml or go.mod changed and neither the matching lockfile was edited nor an install command ran.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: long-run-notify
mods.description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when a Bash command ran longer than a threshold (60 seconds by default). Sends the project name and the seconds only. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: mentor-pack
mods.description: Mentor habits in one install: a hint and a guiding question first, assumptions listed before work, and a strict self-review after each change.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: migration-guard
mods.description: Asks before Write or Edit changes a migration that already exists; new migration files pass.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: migration-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when a schema file changed (schema.prisma, models.py, SQL under schema/, a drizzle schema) and no migration file was created this session.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: model-badge
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the current model name and the context percent (opus-4-1 · 62%).
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: mood-ring
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: night-owl
mods.description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: no-em-dash
mods.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: no-sycophancy
mods.description: No flattery or filler. Disagreement is stated plainly, with the reason.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: no-verify-guard
mods.description: Asks before git hooks are skipped (--no-verify, commit -n, HUSKY=0, core.hooksPath=/dev/null).
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: noir-mode
mods.description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: notify-pack
mods.description: Local alerts in one: a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input (osascript or notify-send), and a spoken line (say) on macOS when a long turn ends.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: now-playing
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the track Music or Spotify plays on your Mac (♪ Song - Artist), read with pgrep and osascript once a minute, only from a player that runs. Hidden when nothing plays.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: ntfy-notify
mods.description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when Claude Code needs your input. The message is generic. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: nudge-pack
mods.description: Two turn-end reminders in one mod: test-reminder and ctx-nudge.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: ops-band
mods.description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: package-guard
mods.description: Asks before a new dependency is installed (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, poetry, cargo, go, gem) and names the packages.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: path-shorten
mods.description: Tool rows draw long absolute file paths shorter: the project root as ./ and your home folder as ~. Display only; Bash commands are drawn as they ran.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: personal-bests
mods.description: Tracks your records across sessions (longest session, most tool calls in a session, most files edited in a day, cheapest session over 30 minutes), toasts a new one, and lists them with /bests.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: pirate-mode
mods.description: Talks like a pirate in prose, never inside code, commands or file contents.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: plain-english
mods.description: Writes in ASD-STE-100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice, simple words.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: port-watch
mods.description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: pr-description
mods.description: Adds /pr-description: title, summary, diff totals and a test plan stub for the current branch against main or master, read with git. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: priority-bar
mods.description: A band above the prompt with your open beads by priority (P0 2 · P1 14 · P2 60 · P3 50), red while a P0 is open, read with bd count every 2 minutes. Hidden without bd.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: process-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the processes the session's Bash calls started that still run, with pid, age and command. Read-only: one ps every 5 seconds. Open it with /procs.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: prod-db-guard
mods.description: Asks before destructive SQL runs in a command: TRUNCATE, DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: protect-main
mods.description: Asks before a commit, push or merge while you are on main or master. Reads the branch with git.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: publish-guard
mods.description: Asks before a package is published: npm, pnpm, yarn or bun publish, cargo publish, twine upload, gem push, poetry or uv publish. Dry runs pass.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: quality-pack
mods.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: type check after TypeScript edits, lockfile after dependency edits, and a split suggestion past 500 changed lines.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: readme-check
mods.description: Adds /readme-check: missing README sections (install, usage, licence, contributing) and broken relative links, at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: ready
mods.description: Adds /ready: the 20 top ready beads, one line each, and the total. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

mods.name: receipt
mods.description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: recent
mods.description: Adds /recent: your last 15 commits across all local branches (author is git user.name), with branch and date. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: registry-push-guard

mods.name: render-pack
mods.description: Both original rendering mods in one: diff-stats bars on Edit and Write rows, and file-links in Claude's replies (a click puts @path in the prompt).

mods.name: render-plus
mods.description: Three row badges in one: time-badge, exit-badge and size-badge.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: reply-language
mods.description: Answers in the language you set (English by default). Code, identifiers and commands stay as they are.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: repo-pack
mods.description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git. They copy results to the clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: reviewer-mode
mods.description: After each code change, reviews its own diff like a strict senior reviewer and lists each issue it found and fixed.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: rubber-duck
mods.description: Restates the problem in its own words and lists its assumptions before it starts work.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: say-done

mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: scripts

mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: secret-commit-guard
mods.description: Asks before a git commit that would record a credential or a secret-named file. Reads the staged diff with git.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: secret-filename-guard
mods.description: Asks before a Bash command touches a secret-looking file (.env, private keys, credentials).
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Asks before a live API key, token or private key is written, edited or run.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: secret-output-guard
mods.description: Tells Claude not to repeat a credential that showed up in command or file output, and names the source to rotate.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: secret-scan
mods.description: Adds /secret-scan: tracked files and line numbers that hold secret-shaped text, found with git grep. Never prints a matched value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.
mods.author: Baselane

mods.name: security-mode

mods.name: zetetic-autopilot
mods.description: Automatic effort and model, and a quota that limits how many agents run, not how well one runs. Every request runs at the effort its grade calls for (zetetic-genius) and the main tool loop steps down the ladder. A subagent runs on the model its Agent call names, else the one its agent definition pins (read from the definition file, since agent.spawn carries only the call's), else the one the DESIGN block of its prompt names, else, for an inheriting type nobody designed, the rung of the dispatch table (hooks/dispatch-table.ts) for its task's class: one haiku completion grades the spawn prompt (routine, planned, bugfix, analysis, critical; a review or not), and the table gives model and effort (no haiku rung; a review runs on opus when complex, else on sonnet). A classifier that gives no class decides nothing: the spawn inherits and a POLICY row says why. Its effort is the Agent call's, else the one its definition sets, else DESIGN's, else the table's; an inheriting type the call gave a model runs every step at the effort of the turn's grade (main's spawns on a graded turn; a fork, a workflow agent or a teammate is never rewritten). No pressure, quota or context changes a model or an effort the orchestrator designed. Each spawn's requested, definition and decided model, what ran, the effort decided for its steps, the table's class and a short reason for each are kept per session. Quota pressure limits concurrency: the cap on subagents running at once falls from max_parallel_agents (5) at an empty five-hour window to 1 at quota_pressure_percent, and a spawn past it is refused with a message the orchestrator reads (wait for a running agent to finish). Only the main loop's own spawns, a fork of main included, are counted and refused: a subagent's nested spawn, a workflow script's agent() and a teammate are not. Main itself drops to sonnet under quota pressure, and doing implementation work in the main loop is warned about (POLICY row, toast), never blocked. A long streaming tool result is written whole to a file in the session's tool-results directory and the model reads a preview and the path (nothing is cut). Owns `phases`: the phase each loop is in (planning, analysis, design, implementation, verification, test, review, report), read off its tool calls or, for an agent, its type; on each run, the steps the stuck escalation raised (counted where each raised step landed, under enforce only); and the advisor calls of main with when they came. The tool loop of a phase the insights calibrated runs at that rung instead of medium (never above the request's grade). Starts in enforce; observe logs the decisions without applying them.
mods.author: cdeust

mods.name: zetetic-genius
mods.description: Grades every request before its turn starts (task class → effort rung, in one low-effort completion) and routes it to the genius reasoning patterns and problem-shaped skills whose trigger it matches, from the installed zetetic-team-subagents index; under enforce, the matched pattern's workflow rides beside the prompt. An analysis or critical request also carries one line asking for the advisor before the first edit and before done.
mods.author: cdeust

mods.name: zetetic-insights
mods.description: The learning loop: every main turn is kept in a ledger across sessions (phase, effort, steps, failed tool calls, agents, advisor calls), joined with the outcomes observed at tool.call (commits kept or reverted, test exits, PR verdicts and merges, no transcript) and the ones /insights writes, and the project's goals; probe sessions are counted and kept out; a phase whose evidence, read on the rung each run had and with Wilson intervals, says so gets its tool-loop effort moved one notch (every applied move is measured pre/post on the same phase, the same task classes and the steps its ceiling decided), written to a calibration file the autopilot reads. /calibrate apply, /calibrate reset. Starts in observe: proposals are shown, not applied.

mods.name: cyberine-snippets
mods.description: Keyboard picker for your saved prompts: search snippet files, fill their placeholders, and drop them into the Claude Code prompt box, plus create, edit, duplicate, move, pin, delete and restore snippets without leaving the session. Snippets are plain Markdown files, not skills, so they cost the model no context until you use one. To work, it watches what you type in the prompt box for the ;; trigger and reads your draft only to insert a snippet or save it as one; a snippet marked submit is sent as a prompt only after you pick it; while you edit a snippet body, Enter saves it instead of sending. mods.name: clauget
mods.description: The scale, then the diet: and the diet only where the scale says it pays. Each model request inside a turn streams through one hook, whose stop chunk carries the four token counters and the model that answered, so the journal has a line per step, the main loop's and every subagent's apart, and names the cache misses where they happen. /clauget opens the report: the window and the cost, the bill of the prefix by provider with how often each provider's tools were called, the break-even of deferring, the instruction files, and every lever with what it saved and what it cost. Out of the box the mod measures and changes nothing. /clauget on, off or strict turns the levers on from the next session: a policy on the prefix decided once and never moved mid-session, tool results cut to the shape of their fat and filed whole so one Read undoes a cut, a small-prefix explorer agent, a lighter transcript for the compaction, economy tiers that tighten with the plan window, a forecast of when it fills, and prompts deferred to its reset. Each lever was measured on a real session; the ones that lost were closed and are named in the README. Nothing the mod writes reaches the model unless a lever puts it there, and then it is counted in the mod's own column.
mods.author: DevOhMyCode

mods.description: One pane of tabs beside the transcript, and the $.cockpit noun other plugins fill. /cockpit opens it, and so does the Cockpit button in the band above the prompt: Session reads the context window, the turn count, the model and the cost, with a Raster sparkline of the context the session has spent turn by turn; Usage draws what the session cost: the four token counters the API reports, kept apart by whether the main loop or a subagent spent them, the models that answered, the plan windows as bars with what is left of each, and what every plugin's skill listing adds to the system prompt each turn; Stats reads ~/.claude/history.jsonl for the prompts this machine has typed: a contribution calendar, sessions, projects, active days and streaks, counted as prompts and never as tokens; Files lists what Claude read and wrote: file tools and shell commands alike: heaviest first, with the lines each file moved and the letter git gives it now, each row a button that rides the file on the next prompt and says so once it has; Tools tallies every tool call with its time and its failures, MCP tools by their server and their own name rather than the prefix they all share, and lists the last of them; Agents is the session's record of every subagent it started, each under the one that spawned it, with how long it ran and the status it ended on. mods.name: message
mods.description: What another session sends lands in a tab instead of in the context. A peer's delivery is written to the mailbox under your home directory, listed in the Message tab beside the thread it belongs to, and announced in one line: and the session's transcript does not grow by a byte. The thread draws each message whole, wrapped to the column it has, with a Show more under the long ones that opens the rest in place: reading what was held has to be free, or holding it saved nothing. You read it and decide: Hand to Claude puts it in the context and starts a turn, which is the only moment it costs anything, or the field at the bottom answers it, calling SendMessage in the session's own loop so that no model turn is started to write three words. The left column lists the sessions running on this machine, read from the engine's own register: the name each goes by: the one /rename sets, and the one SendMessage takes: with the folder it works in and whether it is busy, this session named at the head of it and a refresh button (r) for the moment you rename one next door; the footer counts what was sent without a turn, what is held, and the bytes kept out of the transcript, three figures in two units and no total over them. It is the cockpit's fifth tab where a cockpit is seated, and opens a pane of its own where none is. /message opens it, /message hand hands everything held over at once, /message hold turns the holding off for the session, and /message who answers with the register of sessions this one can write to.

mods.name: offene-punkte
mods.description: Erkennt nach jeder Antwort offene Punkte: Entscheidungen und Aufgaben mit Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung, blockierende zuerst: und stellt sie über der Eingabe, immer auch mit eigener Antwort. Die Liste geht je Projekt in die nächste Sitzung mit (offen.md, offen.json für claude-web), Entscheidungen landen mit Gründen in einem Tagesverlauf. /offen zeigt und bedient alles (auch /offen <Nr> <Text> als freie Antwort, Kurzformen /erledigt <Nr> und /weg <Nr>, /offen alle weg, /offen klären [alle]: „alle“ übernimmt auch Punkte anderer Sitzungen), /zusammenfassung fasst die Sitzung zusammen. /offen übergabe lässt das Hauptmodell eine Übergabe für die nächste Sitzung schreiben (Archiv uebergaben/, Übersicht index.md) und leert danach den Verlauf per /clear (mit „nur“ ohne); die nächste neue Unterhaltung bekommt sie mit der ersten Nachricht, ohne wartende Übergabe den Überblick der letzten Sitzung. /offen übergaben listet das Archiv, /offen übergabe <Nr> zeigt eine. Claude bekommt die offene Liste still mit (und nach jeder Compaction erneut) und schließt Erledigtes und Überholtes selbst („erledigt: #N“ oder per Titel); Veraltetes und nicht aufgegriffene Angebote schließen sich ohne Frage. Beim Start und dann stündlich gleicht Haiku Punkte, die seit sechs Stunden liegen, mit Commits und Entscheidungen ab. Claude trägt neue Punkte selbst über ein Werkzeug ein; Haiku fasst mit kurzem Auftrag nur nach, wenn eine Antwort fragt und nichts eingetragen wurde. Den Überblick schreibt Haiku aus dem Verlauf der Sitzung (alle acht Antworten, nach jeder Compaction, bei /zusammenfassung und /offen überblick) statt per Fork des Hauptmodells. Antworten auf Maschinen-Eingaben (Peer-Nachrichten, Zeitpläne, claude-webs Klärung) werden nicht ausgewertet; ohne Menschen davor (claude -p) bleibt der Mod still; ab haikuBisProzent des 5-Stunden-Fensters ruft er kein Haiku mehr. Jeder Haiku-Aufruf steht mit Tokens in kosten.jsonl. Befehle von außen (claude-web, Skripte) nimmt die Sitzung aus eingang.txt im Projektordner an, je Zeile ein /offen-Befehl. Gedanken (Einfälle, die noch nicht dran sind) führt /offen gedanke in gedanken.md wie claude-web: senden, ins Planungsinterview geben, als Punkt übernehmen, prüfen lassen; Claude setzt den Vermerk per „gedanke erledigt: G3: Commit abc1234“.

mods.name: rocky
mods.description: rocky: the owner's personal agent toolkit. Run many agent sessions from one machine: hand work out (board, handoffs, spawn), bring results back to merge (PR watch, default-branch verify, review-fix), watch and steer from anywhere (web UI, remote control, statusline), and record it all (worklog, token and usage logs). A Rust daemon (127.0.0.1:8636: board REST + streamable HTTP MCP todo_* / note_* / token_*, web UI) and CLI; this plugin is its thin Claude Code client. worklog_* is served per project by the CLI's stdio MCP server (`rocky mcp worklog`). Hooks: SessionStart boots the daemon, UserPromptSubmit injects human board changes, PostToolUse attributes a self-started doing to the session, Stop claims handoffs and auto-captures the turn. A function-hooks module (hooks/board-panel) shows this folder's board in a session pane (/rocky-board). Slash commands, skills and subagents (reviewer, quick-fix, merge-cleanup) cover picking work, PR flow from gate to merge, setup and usage review.

mods.name: doctrine
mods.description: An execution posture for substantial agent work: parallel agents in phases and waves, adversarial red-teaming, looping until confident, ruthless simplicity. Fourteen skills: a shared doctrine, wrappers for coding, web design (the gauntlet loop), debugging, auditing, documentation sweeps, deep research, document writing, and project and epic tracking (doctrine-project), plus doctrine-backup, doctrine-handoff, doctrine-resume and doctrine-primer for session continuity across cleared sessions, and doctrine-pane for an interactive terminal session in a pane the user watches and can take over. Composes with (and degrades gracefully without) Matt Pocock's engineering skills, superpowers, codex, ponytail, and Claude Design. Two prerequisites do not degrade, and both refuse rather than falling back to a weaker version of themselves: doctrine-gauntlet needs Playwright, because its critics judge rendered output: without a browser its harness refuses to run rather than report a pass: and doctrine-pane needs herdr, because an interactive session nobody can watch has no purpose. The other twelve skills need nothing installed.
mods.author: Scott Crosby

mods.name: context-bar
mods.description: A footer showing the model and effort, how full the context window is, and the prompt cache, with one-click compact and clear
mods.author: Zied BEN AMAR

mods.name: crab-buddy
mods.description: A pixel-art Claude crab above the prompt that works, thinks, cheers and sleeps with the session, with a small crab for each subagent, dressed for its kind of work
mods.author: Zied BEN AMAR

mods.name: warm-compact
mods.description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache goes cold, or keeps the cache warm while you're away, so your next prompt doesn't re-read the whole conversation uncached. Two chips under the prompt, /warm-compact and /keep-warm turn each on or off for a session.
mods.author: Zied BEN AMAR

mods.name: collapse-diffs
mods.description: Hides the diff under successful Edit and Write tool rows and under Bash commands that change files

mods.description: Compact reminders as the context grows, a check before resuming a large session after the prompt cache expires, and per-type models with a minimum effort for subagents.

mods.description: Live panel showing this session's context, token and cost usage

mods.name: aside
mods.description: /aside side chat for asking about the conversation without spending its context
